prompt:
Goal: Increase Chu-kei Insight canonical Plan Detection resolved coverage from the current 268 of 3,709 companies to at least 371 resolved companies (10% or higher). Prioritize breadth and high-confidence existing candidates. Use only official or first-party evidence for newly resolved states and preserve company/source/document identity, publication date, plan period or fiscal semantics, currentness, and provenance. Never convert missing, ambiguous, or unreviewed evidence into no_formal_plan or another resolved state merely to raise coverage. Process work in bounded resumable batches, keep canonical and site data aligned, preserve search/browse/detail behavior, and require existing Plan Detection tests, quality gates, source/audit checks, and relevant runtime checks to remain green. Do not add unrelated features. When the canonical summary demonstrates at least 371 resolved companies with these safeguards satisfied, create docs/ADE_COVERAGE_10_COMPLETION.json with schema_version 1, status COMPLETE, final resolved count, coverage, target repository SHA, and concise evidence references. Any human-only publication or external promotion boundary must remain explicit and must not be silently auto-approved.
Outcome: Update `site/data/plan-detection-summary-v1.json` to align site data with canonical registry metrics.
Scope discipline: implement only this task's stated outcome and acceptance. Do not add test code to non-test implementation files or implementation code to dedicated test files unless this task's outcome explicitly requires it.
Allowed paths: site/data/plan-detection-summary-v1.json
Acceptance: Update `site/data/plan-detection-summary-v1.json` to align site data with canonical registry metrics.; Repository CI remains green
Do not modify files outside the allowed paths.
